title: Molecular Dynamics-Derived Coloured Noise Mediates Anderson Localisation and Environment-Assisted Transport of Tryptophan Excitons in Tubulin
summary: The tryptophan residues in tubulin $αβ$-dimers form an ordered aromatic network that has been proposed to support quantum exciton transport even under physiological environmental noise. Existing studies of this system mostly assume white-noise dephasing, but the statistical properties of the protein-solvent bath coupled to tryptophan sites remain uncharacterised under physiological conditions.
